data_scope: Canonical seed-11 observed data imported into a new isolated eval-prep DB; unchanged M3 causal replay generated operational incidents. Ground-truth schema was not queried by preflight or passed to inference. Reserved M9 seeds were not accessed.

evaluation_environment.dataset_import: read-only source import of canonical seed11 into isolated DB
evaluation_environment.provider_mode_at_preflight: disabled; will be enabled only for approved run

freeze_note: Case definitions, incident bindings, evidence cutoffs and scoring rules are frozen. All 40 map to distinct M3 incidents in one isolated database and passed offline evidence/QUALITY/SOP preflight. No provider calls are authorized or executed.

rubric.abstentions: Expected abstention is uncertainty-handling pass, but remains in provider/completion denominator for real-provider runs. Unexpected abstention on answerable evidence fails usefulness. Any local short circuit is separately classified and not counted as provider inference.
rubric.citation_limitation: Identifier and quote verification checks source membership/string match only, not whether the source entails the associated claim.
rubric.failure_counting: Every assigned case stays in the denominator. Provider failure, truncation, schema rejection, citation rejection, missing accepted output, and unexpected abstention are not silently dropped. Report both cohort-wide and eligible-answer conditional rates where useful.
rubric.human_review: Independent human review is required for semantic/factual/procedural/clarity decisions; a second reviewer adjudicates disagreements. No LLM judge and no fabricated scores.
